baseline: da40a72 plus coordinator worktree changes already present
implementation: Added versioned registry metadata for Resize, ToTensor, Normalize and RandomHorizontalFlip, including field types, required values, defaults and help text for CLI forms/autocomplete.
Preserves and executes the exact declared order. Built-ins support PIL images, NumPy images and CHW/BCHW tensors where their contracts allow; no fixed Resize/Normalize ordering rule is imposed.
Added custom Python module:callable transforms with keyword parameters and optional input/output port contracts.
Observes actual type, shape, rank, dtype, storage layout and tensor memory format at each step. Port mismatch and runtime errors identify the exact step and input/output direction.
RandomHorizontalFlip uses a stable per-step seed derived without Python's process-randomized hash, enabling same-input/seed replay.
Embedded the service into the Rust worker bundle and exposed the Python data package functions.

validation.result: passed: 5 transform, 4 classification/sampling, and 4 Dataset adapter integration tests
passed: 58 worker modules, embedded asset coverage complete

limitations: Transform execution is exposed as a worker Python service; the interactive preview and preset flows that call it are separate DATA-04/DATA-05 and CLI integration work.
Built-in image/tensor operations require the corresponding optional runtime library only when invoked. Custom transforms remain unrestricted Python code and run in the selected project environment.
integration_patch: Product document advanced to 0.13.37; task source versions were synchronized. C-data now reflects the ordered transform and step-port service.
